description: Flip a quick-settings tile in the open shade or Control Center. It changes the simulated device like set_device: Wi-Fi and mobile data both off take the network offline, dark_mode changes the app's colour scheme, dnd stops banners. Tiles: wifi, mobile_data, airplane, location, dark_mode, dnd, auto_rotate, flashlight (Android); airplane, wifi, mobile_data, focus, orientation_lock, brightness, dark_mode (iPhone). Fails with tile_not_visible if the panel is closed.

value.description: true or false; 0 to 100 for brightness. Omit to flip.

name: toggle_tile
